#http://codeforces.com/contest/895/problem/0
#solved

n = int(input())
pices = sorted(list(map(int, input().split())))
scores = []
suma2 = 0

for i in range(n):
    suma = 0
    k = i
    while suma <= 180:
        suma2 = suma
        suma += pices[k]

        if k + 1 == n:
            k = -1
        k += 1

    scores.append(min(suma - (360 - suma), (360 - suma2) - suma2))

print(min(scores))
